mcq_fix.s: The Nagara style of temple architecture emerged prominently in which region and period?
mcq_fix.why: 'according to the stated classification' refers to app notes, not an exam phrasing

patterns: APPSC asks builder identification: Chidambaram, Thanjavur, Gangaikondacholapuram = Cholas (y6435f3f745d); AP angle - Draksharama Chalukya-Chola style.
Other PSCs repeat Nataraja iconography (four hands, earrings) and 'greatest iconographic creation = Nataraja'.
Temple-location and style one-liners (Konark Sun temple, Dilwara Mount Abu, Kailasanathar Rajasimha style, Teli temple Dravida pinnacle).
Tamil literature asked as single work-author pairs (Kamban - Ramavataram).
App coverage is close to PYQ depth; extra items on Chola trade terms are deeper than the exam shows.
